description: Bleeding vaginally; Heavy bleeding or spotting
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines; NDHS2022; SMNH Roadmap 2030
notes: Heavy bleeding may indicate serious complication

description: Jerky movement of the body; rolling of eyes
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; SMNH Roadmap 2030

description: BP 140/90 mmHg or above; BP 180/120 mmHg
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; SMNH Roadmap 2030

description: Headache and visual disturbance
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; Maternal Health AI Platform Design
notes: May indicate serious complication in late pregnancy

description: Difficulty to focus the vision; visual disturbance
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; Maternal Health AI Platform Design

description: Body temperature > 37.5 °C; Fever for 3 days
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; SMNH Roadmap 2030

description: Severe pain; upper epigastric pain
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines
notes: Check for ectopic pregnancy or pre-eclampsia

description: Maternal perception of reduced fetal movements
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; SMNH Roadmap 2030; WHO recommendations on maternal health
notes: Advised on reporting frequency in 3rd trimester

description: Shock; Fainting; Unrecordable BP & pulse
recommended_action: Management of shock and immediate referral
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; SMNH Roadmap 2030

description: Foul vaginal discharge; foul smelly liquor
recommended_action: Refer to BEONC or CEONC site
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; SMNH Roadmap 2030

description: Water broke; PV leaking for 4 days
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; Maternal Health AI Platform Design

description: Pedal edema; Swelling of face or hands
recommended_action: Check for symptoms of severe pre-eclampsia
source: Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; Maternal Health AI Platform Design

description: Vomited twice at home; persistent vomiting
source: Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual

description: Severe difficulty breathing; respiratory distress
source: Digital ANC Who guidelines; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual
notes: May indicate heart disease or ARDS

description: Manual removal needed; Inversion of the uterus
recommended_action: Parenteral oxytocic drugs and immediate referral
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; SMNH Roadmap 2030

description: Labour more than 24 hours; Obstructed labour
recommended_action: Facility delivery after 12 hours of labour
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; SMNH Roadmap 2030

description: Breech, transverse, oblique; Hand/foot/cord prolapse
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual
notes: Requires emergency C-section or assisted delivery

description: Very pale; Pallor in conjunctiva, fingernails, eyelid
recommended_action: Full blood count testing; Iron supplementation
source: A Report on Maternal Mortality; Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; NDHS2022; WHO recommendations on maternal health

description: Urine dipstick result protein ++ or +++
source: Digital ANC Who guidelines

description: Palpitations; Chest pain with household work
source: Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual
notes: Primary cause linked to Heart Disease

description: Feeling down, depressed or hopeless
source: Hospital-MPDSR-Training-Manual; SMNH Roadmap 2030
notes: Affects 20-30 women for every maternal death

description: Traumatic injury repeated; Intrusive partner
source: Digital ANC Who guidelines; WHO recommendations on maternal health; Who Guidelines ANC
notes: Minimum safety requirements must be met
